fields.System.Title: OUT-306 — Block release until replenishment completes
fields.System.Description:
Story

As a supervisor, I want a wave held until its pick faces are stocked, so that pickers
do not hit empty locations halfway through committed work.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given a wave whose demand exceeds current pick face stock, then replenishment tasks
  • are created before release.
  • - Given outstanding replenishment tasks for the wave, then release is blocked or a
  • prominent warning requires explicit override.
  • - Given an override, then the acting user and reason are recorded.
  • - Given replenishment tasks created for a wave, then they are prioritised above general
  • replenishment work.
  • - Given the tasks complete, then the wave becomes releasable without further action.

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | outbound, replenishment |
| Tables | wave, replen_task |
| Risks | Pickers hitting empty faces mid-wave ([doc 05 WF 5](../../../docs/05-workflows.md)); replen completing too late ([doc 09 §7.3](../../../docs/09-defect-hotspots.md)) |
| Tests | integration |
